description:
Goal
Collapse callable flow, callable descriptor facts, and boundary selection into one producer-identity projection. A callable value's contract is minted at the producer as CallableFlowFact and transported by identity; ShapeId remains pure layout.

Design intent
The concepts currently split across CallableFlowFact, CallableDescr, CallableFacts, BoundaryDescr, and native settled_callable_boundary are all expressions of one principle: a callable value has a producer identity plus observed surfaces. Layout answers how many lanes carry the value; the producer contract answers which target/surface/boundary those lanes mean. Consumers must not re-derive that from capture-prefix position or sibling shape.

Required work
- Introduce the minimal identity key needed for transport callable facts, likely producer executable + producer ValueId or a stable local callable producer key, and thread it from runtime demand into transport CallableFacts/BoundaryFacts.
- Make CallableDescr only a layout descriptor (function/capture lane layout) or replace it where it currently smuggles semantic identity; move semantic identity to facts keyed by the producer contract.
- Ensure callable_for_producer and generic_callable_shape project from upstream CallableFlowFact only; any missing flow is a fail-loud upstream-demand bug caught by fz-f98.1 telemetry.
- Remove duplicate consumer-side recovery that matches by function + capture_count + position when a producer fact should already name the contract.

Checks
- Direct reducer capture-prefix tests still pass.
- The Range scalar-reducer case no longer produces capture_count 0/1 divergence for one target function.
- No special cases for Range, Map, or Enum helpers.
title: Make callable contracts producer-identity projections, not layout-derived descriptors
